# One line per upstream file: <bucket/key in the store> <source URL> <check mode> <expand>
#
# check mode  head    HEAD the URL, send only when its ETag or length changed
#             nohead  upstream answers GET only, so the dedupe key comes from the file itself
#             always  fetch on every run (the GeoIP index, whose records carry the hashes)
#             inline  the content is generated by the flow, not fetched
# expand      -        nothing more to do
#             endpoint unzip the manifest and queue every artifact it lists
#             geoip    split the index JSON, queue each database, write overview.json
#             kb       queue the newest Security Labs zip named in the bucket listing
#
# #{elastic.stack.version} and #{elastic.kb.version} are NiFi parameters (for example 9.5.2 and 9.5).
